meta.capture_method: Direct HTTPS GET against the official Kalshi demo Trade API using public (unauthenticated) endpoints.
meta.note: Point-in-time snapshot. Every row carries the exact endpoint URL in source_url. Fields the API did not return are null and are listed as unverified on the Flagged for Review page. Nothing on this site is inferred.
